sense.text:
Before getting to the hammer of the earth, know this: this truth cannot be stopped, and the precepts show it is not going to stop.

Moses “was in the church in the wilderness”, and the church in the wilderness was Israel. There is no such thing in the Bible as the Baptist church, the Pentecostal church, the Roman Catholic Church, the Jehovah’s Witness church or the Seventh-day Adventist church. The only church is the twelve tribes of Israel.

Our fathers “received the lively oracles to give unto us.” The lively oracles are the law. That is what gives us life, when we keep it.

precepts.why:
You have to be preemptive when dealing with Christians. Someone will try to be slick and say the other nations are part of the church too, and they will go here: “And a mixed multitude went up also with them.” Other nations were there with Israel, they say, so they are part of that church.

The answer is no, they are not. Who that mixed multitude was is proved in Leviticus 25.

The mixed multitude were the strangers among us, and here is what God said about them: “Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy”. That is the mixed multitude. “And they shall be your possession.”

“And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.”

So that mixed multitude was not our brothers. They were our slaves. They were never the church in the wilderness; the church was the children of Israel.

sense.text:
“And the government shall be upon his shoulder.” When Acts 7 talks about the church, it is talking about the government of Christ.

His name is called “The everlasting Father”, because many times in the Old Testament, when you read about the father, it is making reference to Christ. That is why, when Philip said to Christ, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us, he answered, have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me. Christ was letting him know: I am the father that created you. Not the Father, but your father.

“Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end.” Increase means it starts small. Christ said the kingdom of heaven starts like a mustard seed, but in the end it is the largest. Once it started as a mustard seed, it kept growing, and there is no stopping it. Highlight that part: “there shall be no end.”

It is upon the throne of David, to order it and to establish it with judgment and with justice, “from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.” I don’t care how many Israelites they attempt to kill or arrest. It ain’t going to stop.

precepts.why:
We just read that of the increase of his government there shall be no end. Daniel says the same thing: “And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed”.

The days of these kings are the days of those last kings, the ten toes, the ten common markets; America is that iron and that clay. In the days of these kings the God of heaven sets up a kingdom, and this is what is happening now: Israelites are waking up all over the world. Highlight it: “which shall never be destroyed.”

Asked once in an interview what the difference is between Israel United in Christ and people like the Black Panthers, Martin Luther King, SNCC or the Young Lords, the answer was: those were all man-made. They all had an end, and most of them don’t even exist today. But this kingdom shall never be destroyed. It is saying the same thing as Isaiah 9: of the increase of his government there shall be no end.

sense.text: Christ asks, “But whom say ye that I am?” and Simon Peter answers, “Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.” Flesh and blood did not reveal it to him, but the Father which is in heaven.

Eighteen is the key. “Upon this rock”: Christ is talking about himself, not Peter. “I will build my church”: that church is the government we just read about in Isaiah 9, the same church that was in the wilderness in Acts 7:38.

“And the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.” That means there ain’t no stopping us. You cannot stop this truth from continuing. Once you get the proper understanding of the word of God, you can’t stop it. It is going to flourish and it is going to grow.

The gates of hell will attempt to stop it, but they won’t prevail. They attempted to stop it when they murdered Nat Turner, when they murdered Denmark Vesey, when they murdered Gabriel Prosser. Those men knew that they were Israelites, and they said, kill them, kill them. It didn’t stop. Through whispers and hushes, this word kept going.

precepts.why:
What are the gates of hell that are going to try to stop this? “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood”. Sometimes we get in our carnal mind and say, if we organize, we can overthrow the system. No, you can’t. This ain’t a flesh and blood fight. It is “against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.”

That is letting you know the governments on this earth are set up by Satan, and God allows it. The fallen angels, Satan and his minions, are the white man. Look at the pyramid: at the top, on the dollar bill, the all-seeing eye; then the Rothschilds, the Rockefellers, some thirteen super rich families and the secret societies; the world leaders; the Vatican and the policy makers over the religious leaders and politicians; Hollywood and the music industry over the entertainers and the influential people; law enforcement, the FBI, the police, the IRS; and at the bottom, the common population. That is you and me.

The second picture shows the same: the crown, the Council of 13, the Committee of 300, the think tanks (the Trilateral Commission, the Royal Institute of International Affairs, the Council on Foreign Relations, the United Nations, the Bilderberg Group, the Club of Rome), world financial control (the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, the central banks, the Bank for International Settlements), world resource control, then religion teaching heavenly rewards for obeying rules, government, education programming the intellectual with the status quo, and the media carrying the elite’s message to the masses. At the bottom is the population, labor units and debt slaves, with an arrow saying you are here. They all work in conjunction with each other. When Trump threatened to take Canada, the rich man who ran the electrical grid running from Canada down through the Northeast said he would shut off all their electricity, and Trump had to back up. They work together.

That is the gates of hell. If you think you can overthrow this system, you would have to go through all of that, and only God can do that.

Daniel proves it: the Lord sets these wicked men up. “This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.”

The Lord allows Satan to set all of this up. He sets up over it the basest of men, and it is through Satan. That is why, with Ephesians 6, you cannot overthrow it in your own strength.

We are at the bottom of that pyramid, and they say we are nothing, we’re sheep. So how do we get out of this system? First: “Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.”

Then: “For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.” That is how we get out of here: through the foolishness of preaching. We ain’t worried about them. They are just talking smack on the streets and on YouTube. The pride of their heart has deceived them.

“For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise”. That’s you and me. “And God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty”. We are the weak things to confound the mighty.

“And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen”. We’re the base, and we are the ones despised. “Yea, and things which are not”, meaning we’re not a people, “to bring to nought things that are”. We are being used to bring to nought the things that are, “That no flesh should glory in his presence.”

The Lord didn’t call us into his truth because we did something magnanimous in our lives. He chose us from the beginning, before the earth was made: “According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love”. Holy and without blame, in keeping the commandments.

“Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself”. We were predestined to wake up in these last days and believe, “according to the good pleasure of his will”.

This is why the gates of hell shall not prevail and why Daniel 2:44 says the kingdom shall never be destroyed. It is what you are seeing now, and it is why many Christian apologists are afraid. Very afraid.

Here is more on the gates of hell. “Woe to the bloody city!” America is the bloody city. Did she not spill the blood of the tribes of Gad, Reuben and Issachar just to steal this country? Upon the blood of our brothers and sisters they set up churches, courthouses and school institutions to indoctrinate us. “It is all full of lies and robbery”. This country is full of lies, and robbery.

“The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.” It goes up in time: the whip when riding the horse, the rattling wheels of the chariots and stagecoaches, the prancing horses, and the jumping chariots, which are your helicopters and things like that.

“There is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses”. Carcases mean dead bodies. They were slaughtering us, killing us.

“Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot”. America is the wellfavoured harlot. Everybody wants to live in America; some kissed the ground when they got here, and then didn’t see no golden streets. She is “the mistress of witchcrafts”. That is the gates of hell. If you didn’t know it was her, it tells you she “selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” The nations she sold were the two kingdoms of Judah and Ephraim.

sense.text:
Still dealing with the gates of hell, and with Ephesians 6:12, the principalities and the spiritual wickedness in high places. The “virgin daughter of Babylon” is America. A Christian apologist will say the daughter of Babylon was the ancient Babylonians, the Kushites. No.

“Sit in the dust”: sit in confusion. “Sit on the ground: there is no throne”: your throne is finished, your kingdom is over. “O daughter of the Chaldeans”: that is the other group of them, the ones over in Israel.

“For thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate”: no more called Christian or Jew. You say, oh, those are the chosen ones, those are God’s holy people. No more.

“Take the millstones, and grind meal”: it is about slavery. They are going to be working in the fields.

“Uncover thy locks”: as a holy woman, her head is covered. God says uncover your locks, because you are not holy. You are not Christian, and you are not a Jew. “Make bare the leg”: lift up your skirt; the leg is from the ankle to the knee. “Uncover the thigh”: that is from the knee to the waist.

“Pass over the rivers”: the rivers are the word of God. It is the word of God that is revealing their nakedness. America is not Christian, and the Jews are not Israel. They are all frauds.

“Thy nakedness shall be uncovered”: the word of God is revealing their nakedness. “Yea, thy shame shall be seen.” All their shameful deeds are being revealed by the word of God.

“I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” Christ is not going to meet them like a man.

precepts.why:
Who is the daughter of Babylon? “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem”. Edom means red: the red people, the red race. That is your so-called white man. They are the ones “who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.”

Then it calls them by name: “O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”. Your destiny is to be destroyed. “Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.” How did they do us? Murder and slavery. So what is going to happen to them? Murder and slavery. “Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.”

So the virgin daughter of Babylon in Isaiah 47 is Edom, America.

Christ is to “sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word”. The water is the word of God.

So when Isaiah says “pass over the rivers”, it means pass over the word of God. The rivers, the word of God, are what uncover her nakedness and let her shame be seen.

sense.text: “Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee”: with all the technological advances they’ve got, their knowledge and wisdom has perverted them. “I am, and none else beside me”: they are saying they are God, and there is no God besides them.

“Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth”. That is when the nations attack them: their friends, their allies. “Desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.” Obadiah shows who it is, and now we understand what verse 11 is talking about. You can’t make this stuff up.

“Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries”. All that technology is sorcery. “Wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth”: since the inception of the United States of America, since 1776, they have used witchcraft. Follow the streets in the layout of Washington DC and they form the pentagram, the five-pointed star. You thought it was a God-fearing country. Oh, no. They deal with sorcery and witchcraft. What is coming out in the Epstein letters now, that they have been killing little babies and drinking, you can call me crazy, but I do believe there is some truth to that stuff.
Let the astrologers, the stargazers and the monthly prognosticators stand up and save thee. This is the gates of hell, the spiritual wickedness in high places of Ephesians 6:12.

“They shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame”. That is destruction. “There shall not be a coal to warm at”: you ain’t going to get no comfort.
“Even thy merchants, from thy youth”: the merchants are your corporations. “None shall save thee.”

precepts.why:
What is the evil that comes upon them suddenly, which they shall not know? “All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border”. The men confederate with them are their allies: Germany, France, Britain. “The men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee”: those nations at peace with you, America, have deceived you and prevailed against you.

“They that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee”. America shared technology, food and all kinds of resources with her allies. America brought those countries up. They didn’t share with Africa: they told Africa you’re not even allowed to make weapons; we’ll make them and send you small caliber, outdated ones. In Haiti they have guns from 1930. In Uganda the president’s security had old rusty guns.

So the evil that rises without them knowing from where is their own allies turning on them.

sense.text:
“What iniquity have your fathers found in me”: what iniquity have our fathers found in the one true God, “that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?”

“Neither said they, Where is the Lord that brought us up out of the land of Egypt”. Our people don’t ask that, because it would mean they would have to acknowledge that they are the Israelites. The land of deserts and of pits is the wilderness, where we dwelt forty years on the way to the promised land because of our rebelliousness.

“I brought you into a plentiful country”: the land of Canaan, which became known as the land of Israel. “But when ye entered, ye defiled my land”: when our ancestors entered, we defiled the holy land “and made mine heritage an abomination.”

“The priests said not, Where is the Lord?” and those priests that handled the law did not know God. “The pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal”.

You might say today is different. It is not. Pastor Pam tells the church that nothing that goes in you defiles you, bless your food and eat the pork; but Jesus never said that pig is clean, and nobody from Genesis to Revelation is eating anything unclean. Pastor Pam is prophesying after Baal.

The black church has had sixty years since the civil rights of 1965, and nothing has changed; now it is going back to the way it was before. In the Christian church the women set the pastor above their husbands. Sisters in IUIC have come to the leaders because the husband told her to do something she didn’t like, wanting them to be a whipping stick. You are supposed to be subject to your husband in all things, so sit your black behind down. The churches are creating weak, beta male soy boys, and they are filled with fat black women. And the dancing in the church is total foolishness.

The book African-Americans: A Concise History shows it: most congregations did not want scholarly or theologically sound sermons, many black ministers had little or no education, Booker T. Washington said three-fourths of the Baptist ministers and two-thirds of the Methodists were unfit mentally or morally or both, and W. E. B. Du Bois wanted the churches free of the noisy and unclean leaders. Black clergymen refused to challenge white supremacy. Don’t we see that today? The black church says nothing against white supremacy. You have been sold a bill of goods. These pastors have immoral ways about them, and that is what Jeremiah 2 is talking about.

“Against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans”. The Bible often breaks the two up. Ancient Babylon were Kushites, but the Chaldeans were Semites, Shemites. So Babylon here is America, and the Chaldeans are the ones over there in Israel, the more smart, the educated ones.

“Set up a standard; publish, and conceal not”: conceal not means don’t hide it. Say “Babylon is taken”: Babylon shall be destroyed. “Bel is confounded”: your idols shall be confounded. “Merodach is broken in pieces”: Merodach was the eagle god.

“For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her”. When you look at the north, that includes NATO, which is north above Israel, and Russia, which is north above Israel. These countries from the north will come down and fight.

Underline “none shall dwell therein.” Christians will say this is ancient Babylon. But when Persia and Media conquered Babylon, they took over the land and the palace and dwelt there (Daniel 5). So this is not talking about ancient Babylon. This Babylon is this place here, prophetically. “They shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.”

“The children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the Lord their God.” That is what is happening now. Brothers and sisters are going weeping, saying I need the Lord, I need to know what’s going on, I need to get myself right.

“They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to the Lord in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.” That is Daniel 2:44 again: in the days of these kings the Lord God sets up a kingdom. We are coming back to who we are.

“My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray”. Mike Todd is a perfect example: a pastor saying he wished God had made it simpler, wishing there was an option of other in the kingdom, and not knowing what he thinks about gay men. The result of teachings like that is black men in a Christian church wearing red dresses for a charity event. A man ain’t got no business in a dress, period.

“They have turned them away on the mountains”, because the mountains are where they worshiped. “They have gone from mountain to hill”: from one religion to another religion. “They have forgotten their restingplace”: our resting place is the Bible, the word of God, and we have forgotten it.

These are the shepherds of our people: a pastor in Miami introducing his partner as his first gentleman, and the black women who support it, single black women raising effeminate little boys and then saying they can’t find a good man. A North Tulsa pastor sentenced for raping his own daughter, and the daughter forgiving him because she is a Christian. When you see a fat pastor, you can’t trust him: number one, he’s a Christian; number two, he’s fat, he cannot discipline his urges, his lust and his food intake. Never trust a fat black pastor. A Clarksville pastor arrested for rape of girls aged fifteen and thirteen, and two pastors in Baltimore charged with murdering a blind, mentally disabled man for insurance money. That is how the shepherds have caused them to go astray.

“All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not”. The nations that conquered us said, we are not offending anything, “because they have sinned against the Lord”: because these blacks and Latinos have sinned against the Lord, “the hope of their fathers.”

Even a white preacher says ninety to ninety-five percent of the black church is heretical and needs to go find a white churchman. That is what the brother was reading from the book: Du Bois and Booker T. Washington were saying the black churches are garbage. You learn nothing; all you do is jump up and down and give money.

“Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.” Be as the he goats: lead the people away, lead them out, go someplace, because a time of Jacob’s trouble is coming.

“An assembly of great nations from the north country”: write that down, NATO and Russia. “Their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man”: the arrows are missiles, and “none shall return in vain.”

“And Chaldea shall be a spoil”: don’t think little Israel is getting away over there.
“O ye destroyers of mine heritage”: this is what Edom did against us. Esau destroyed our people, the twelve tribes of Israel; they were the first and most instrumental of all the nations.

“Your mother shall be sore confounded”. Who is the mother of America? Britain, Great Britain. “She that bare you shall be ashamed.”

“It shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate”. Remember Daniel 5: the Medes took over the palace in Babylon and dwelt there, so this did not happen back then. It is talking about the time to come.

“Spare no arrows”: spare no missiles, “for she hath sinned against the Lord.” What they did to us was a sin. “Her walls are thrown down”, because of the missiles striking this place.

“For it is the vengeance of the Lord: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.” Jeremiah is saying the same thing John the Revelator said.

“Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle”: the farmers. “For fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people”: it is going to be a time of nationalism. You see it now with Esau’s new evangelical nationalists. Every nation is going to return to its own people, and all that interracial stuff is going to end, because it is not of the Lord.

“Israel is a scattered sheep”. First the king of Assyria devoured the northern kingdom, and last Nebuchadrezzar broke our bones. “I will bring Israel again to his habitation”: that happened in the time of Cyrus.

“The iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none”. That didn’t happen yet. When we went back to the land, Nehemiah and Ezra show all kinds of sin we were committing, particularly interracial marriages. Jeremiah goes from one time period to the next, and verse 20 goes forward to the kingdom.

No iniquity found in Israel, and the sins of Judah not found: God is going to pardon us. “For I will pardon them whom I reserve.”
“The land of Merathaim”: write it down, that is another name for Babylon. “The inhabitants of Pekod”: that is the Chaldeans. “Waste and utterly destroy after them”.

“How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken!” It is calling Babylon, the United States of America, the hammer of the whole earth.

They know it. They called the strike on Iran’s nuclear sites Operation Midnight Hammer: seven B-2 bombers, 125 warplanes, warships and submarines, fourteen of their most powerful bunker-busting bombs dropped on Fordow and Natanz in twenty-five minutes. They name these things after biblical names because their scholars know exactly who they are. It’s the church down here, our people, who are clueless.

precepts.why:
Christians will say Jeremiah 50 is talking about ancient Babylon. Let’s see: “In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain. And Darius the Median took the kingdom”.

When Persia and Media conquered Babylon, they took the land over and the palace over, and they were dwelling there. But Jeremiah says “none shall dwell therein.” So he is not talking about ancient Babylon. This Babylon is the place here, prophetically.

Christians don’t want to change, just as the Pharisees didn’t want to change. This is how the Pharisees and scribes felt about Christ’s teaching, and it goes up to today, how Christians feel about the true teaching of Christ and the Israelites.

“No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old”. Christ is the new garment: the new covenant was being ushered in, and they weren’t ready for it. “The piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old”, meaning the old covenant: animal sacrifice was replaced by the sacrifice of Christ.

“No man putteth new wine into old bottles”. The new wine is the new covenant in Christ, and it “must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.” The new bottles are us being born again: new creatures, new men, new women.

“No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.” They said the old covenant, the old understanding, is better. So it is today. Our people like their old ways and their old traditions. We introduce them to the new covenant in Christ by keeping the commandments, and they say, I don’t want that. So the adversaries say, “We offend not”.

“Be as the he goats before the flocks”, and Ezra shows what it means: “O my people, hear my word: make you ready to thy battle”. Prepare your hearts and your souls, because this is a spiritual battle. “And in those evils be even as pilgrims upon the earth”: be ready to up and go.

“He that selleth, let him be as he that fleeth away”, he that buildeth “as he that shall not dwell therein”, they that marry “as they that shall get no children”, “And therefore they that labour labour in vain”. He explains it: “For strangers shall reap their fruits, and spoil their goods, overthrow their houses, and take their children captives”.

“And they that occupy their merchandise with robbery”: these strangers are going to occupy our merchandise and our homes. Imagine a famine hits and people are running crazy, especially in black and Latino communities. They figure you’ve got food in your house, and they are coming to rob what you’ve got. “The more they deck their cities, their houses, their possessions, and their own persons”, because they’re wearing your clothes, “The more will I be angry with them for their sin, saith the Lord.”

Why is this going to happen? “For there shall be in every place, and in the next cities, a great insurrection upon those that fear the Lord.”

It is not if, it is when this will come to pass. That is why we must be as the he goats before the flocks, ready to lead the people out of the midst of Babylon.

“As she hath done, do unto her”, and watch what John the Revelator said: “Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.”

Everything Babylon did to our race, our people, our twelve tribes, God said it is going to be double upon America. Jeremiah is saying the same thing John the Revelator said.

“For I will pardon them”, and this is what goes with it: “There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.”

If we walk in Christ, there is no condemnation. That is how the iniquity of Israel is sought for and none found.

“And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.” No guile, no deceit, without fault before the throne. That is Israel in that day, when the sins of Judah shall not be found.

“He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.”

“Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.” That is why there shall be none: God casts our sins into the depths of the sea for the oath he swore to our fathers.

“Whom I reserve”, and Isaiah says the same thing: “For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel”. He is going to have mercy on us and will yet choose us, because we are in the midst of sin. We are wicked, always confounded, always in some struggle, and he said, I will yet choose them. Nobody has anything to say about it.

So he ain’t having mercy on all the nations on the planet. He ain’t pardoning all the nations on the planet. He pardons Israel, whom he reserves.

America knows she is the hammer of the earth, and here is Isaiah on the hammer: “He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”. If there is ever peace, the white man will make sure there is no peace. Peace disturbs him and angers him; it’s too quiet, we got to go start a war somewhere. “He that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted”. Now he is going to get persecuted.

“That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?” America, the hammer of the earth, made the world a wilderness. We are his prisoners, and he ain’t letting us go.

“Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial”. When America goes down, God is saying America, Lucifer, Babylon will not have a decent burial or a nice memorial, “because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people”. How do they do that? COVID: America created that thing and it killed a whole lot of white people, a majority of them Esau. They poison their own land and waters, like Flint, Michigan. 9/11.

“The seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.” The seed of evildoers is the gates of hell, the wicked principalities, the spiritual wickedness in high places of Ephesians 6:12. “Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers”: this is what God says.

Churches read verse 12 and say, oh, it’s talking about Lucifer. But from verse 4 it tells you who: “thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” Babylon is an oppressive system as well as a golden city, rich beyond belief. Then “How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!” God is calling Babylon Lucifer: think of the Statue of Liberty. “How art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!”

“They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms”. So Babylon, Lucifer, is a man on earth. What man? Edom, the white man. Then it goes back to calling him Babylon in case you forgot: “For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew”, and “I will sweep it with the besom of destruction”. Babylon is Lucifer, is man, is the United States of America. That didn’t happen in the time of Belshazzar or any of them. It is yet to come.

sense.text: “Behold, a people shall come from the north”: here we go again, NATO, including Russia. “Many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth”: we are seeing that now.

“They are cruel, and will not shew mercy”: when these nations come against America, they will show no mercy. “Against thee, O daughter of Babylon.” Now it goes from calling it Babylon to revealing it is the daughter of Babylon. Who is that? Edom, Psalms 137:8. It is still America, but Edom.

“The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them”: he is going to hear that his allies have turned against him. I thought France was our friend. I thought England was our friend. I thought Germany was our friend. We the G7, baby. And now it is all going to flip on them. “His hands waxed feeble”: America is going to get scared.

“He shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan”. The Jordan River swells in Abib, around Passover.

“Who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me?” There is no man worthy enough to take down Babylon but the Lord. Once those nations destroy the country, Babylon is still not down. She has military bases all over the world; like Olympus Has Fallen, the White House goes down but the military is still in full effect. That is why Isaiah 47 says, I will not meet thee as a man. Although the country is destroyed, America is still up and fighting, so God himself steps in.

“Hear ye the counsel of the Lord”: the counsel of the Lord is the Bible. “Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out”. The least of the flock is the so-called Israelis, that tiny speck in the midst of the Arab world, of all those brown and black nations. They will draw out Babylon. There is going to be turmoil over there, they will cry help us, and America is going to try to come to their rescue.

It is good that these so-called Israelis keep attacking and asking America to bomb everybody, because the other nations are getting sick of America and sick of the Israelis. Netanyahu was in Washington, then destroyers went toward Iran; the Arabs will unite, there will be war, America will run over to save the Israelis, and that is where their military gets destroyed. Israel bombed Qatar, a friend of the US, trying to kill the Hamas negotiators during the very peace talks.

“Surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them”: America is going to be desolate, and little Israel over there is going to get wiped out.
“At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.” Everybody is going to hear about the destruction of Babylon the Great.

“For Israel hath not been forsaken”. That is us. It might seem like we have been, because we are down and out at the bottom, but Israel has not been forsaken, because of the covenant the Lord made with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. He sent his son Christ to die for our sins, “though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.”

And the nations from the north are lining up: the warning is out of Israel that Turkey is the new Iran, seeking to encircle Israel. Turkey is north of Israel, so a lot of countries from the north are going to come down against these people.

“How is Sheshach taken!” Sheshach is another name for Babylon; write it down. “How is the praise of the whole earth surprised!” America is the praise of the whole earth: everybody’s got God bless America. “How is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!” All the nations are going to be astonished, shocked, when she goes down.
“The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.” The sea and the waves are the nations.
“A land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.” This hasn’t happened yet. This is yet to come.

“I will punish Bel in Babylon”. Bel was a foreign god, a false god, and that Bel today is Cesare Borgia, the god of Babylon. “The nations shall not flow together any more unto him”. In the dream of Daniel 2 the last kingdom was a mix of all nations; that is America, and God says, I’m going to put an end to that. “Yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.”
“My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the Lord.” Revelation 18:4 says the same exact thing.

“Lest your heart faint”: don’t give up. “And ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land”. A rumor is something we hear or talk about that has not occurred yet. “A rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler”: the rumors will come to pass.

Right now World War III, Armageddon, is a rumor. Trump even told the president of Ukraine that he was about to start World War III: that is a rumor. That is supposed to encourage us, because we know this place must come to an end. Brothers and sisters, we must go home.

“I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon”: Babylon has a lot of graven images. “Her whole land shall be confounded”: all of America. “All her slain shall fall in the midst of her”: you are going to see a lot of these church groups put to death, because they all believe in the United States of America. They don’t really want the kingdom of heaven on earth.

“Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon”. That sounds exactly like Isaiah 14. “For the spoilers shall come unto her from the north”: now we find out Turkey is going to be included in that. Turkey, NATO, Russia.

“As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall”: they are the ones killing us. “So at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.” Now Turkey is trying to make an alliance with Saudi Arabia and with Pakistan, and Isaiah 21 shows what is coming.

precepts.why:
“Behold, I am against thee, O Tyrus”. Tyrus is another metaphor. “And will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.”

So when Jeremiah says “The sea is come up upon Babylon”, the sea is the nations, and the multitude of the waves is the nations coming up against her.

John the Revelator says the same exact thing: “Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.”

If we are partakers of America’s sins, we will receive the plagues that come here. Those nuclear bombs: we will get caught up in that. So come out of Christmas and Easter, Kwanzaa, Memorial Day, all the foolishness that is done here, and return to the one true God by keeping his commandments.

“And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars”. We are at that point now. “See that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.”

Now we are near the end. The rumor heard in the land, one year and then another, is the rumors of wars, and then comes violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

Seven is the point. “He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.” Then: “The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet”. When Babylon is persecuted and brought down, the whole earth will be at rest and quiet.

“They break forth into singing.” All the world will break forth into singing. Everybody is going to be glad when this place goes down. That is the heaven and the earth singing for Babylon.

“And in her”, in Babylon, “was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.”

Babylon has caused the slain of Israel to fall. They are the ones killing us, and so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.

sense.text: “The burden of the desert of the sea.” It comes “from the desert, from a terrible land.” Now we are going to find out who he is talking about.

“The treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously”. This is America. America will ask you to come and have a peace talk and then bomb your country; that is what they did to Iran. Now they tell all the nations, take the deal, and it is a terrible deal: only white folks can have nuclear weapons, but you brown people, no weapons for you. Take the deal or we’re going to end you.

“Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media”. Elam is Iran, and that includes Pakistan, India, that whole section over there. “All the sighing thereof have I made to cease”: they are going to finally have enough and attack. Right now they are in a sighing period. America bombed them, destroyed their bases, killed their generals with drones, and they said not yet, we can’t fight yet, we still have to build up our arsenal; let’s be patient.

“Therefore are my loins filled with pain”. Why is Isaiah terrified like this? Because he is not looking at the vision the way you look at the screen on your phone. The Most High puts you in the future, in the destruction. He was looking at all the destruction happening all around him: “I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.” He heard it and saw it, in the midst of it in the spirit realm. “The night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.”

“Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.” Anoint the shield means prepare for war. On a castle or palace there is a watchtower at the very top, where you can see for miles, and you had to stay there for hours. So you had to bring food and drink with you to go through the night until your shift changed, watching for any enemy approaching. You couldn’t be one of those sleepy brothers.

“Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.” “He saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen”: a couple is two, a chariot with two horses running towards him. “And he cried, A lion”: he cried like a lion, screaming what he sees, men coming back from the battle.

“Babylon is fallen, is fallen”. The people that just came back are screaming Babylon is destroyed; we just heard America is finished. It says is fallen, is fallen, because Israel is going to fall too: the Israelis are going to be wiped out over there. “All the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground”: Cesare Borgia, Santa Claus, your Thanksgiving turkeys, your Easter bunny, Zeus, those Greek statues they have everywhere. All of that is going to be finished.
“The burden of Dumah.” Dumah is one of Ishmael’s sons. “He calleth to me out of Seir”, because the Arabs are over there, where Petra is. “Watchman, what of the night?”
“The burden upon Arabia.” This Arabia is Saudi Arabia. “O ye travelling companies of Dedanim”: Dedan, of the sons of Abraham by Keturah.

“The inhabitants of the land of Tema”: still Ishmael’s sons, the Arabs. The people running back from the war are fainting for thirst, so the Arabs give them water, and “they prevented with their bread him that fled”: they kept them from dying with water and bread. “For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow”: that is the missiles, “and from the grievousness of war.”

“All the glory of Kedar shall fail”. Kedar is Saudi Arabia. Look at that word glory: there are parts of Saudi Arabia that are beautiful, and the women want to go to Dubai; it makes that place over there glorious. But the Bible says all the glory of Kedar shall fail. “The mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished”: they are going to get wiped out. “For the Lord God of Israel hath spoken it”, and nobody has anything to say.

Watch it unfolding: after a year of talks, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkey have prepared a defense pact, with Pakistan’s nuclear weapons, an alliance like NATO’s Article 5 that all the Muslim countries may join. Turkey is part of NATO, but Erdogan hates the Israelis so much he wants a NATO of the Arab nations.

precepts.why:
Who is Dumah? “Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham”. The sons of Ishmael: “Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam, And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa, Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah”. See Dumah right there.

“These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.”

All the Arabs, following Muhammad’s example, claim descent from Ishmael, and the scholars know it. So the burden of Dumah is a burden on the Arabs, and Kedar is in the same list.

“Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.” She bare him sons, “And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.”

See that Dedan? That is the Dedanim we are reading about in Isaiah 21, the travelling companies lodging in the forest in Arabia.

“Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah”. Tema is a son of Ishmael. So the inhabitants of the land of Tema are still Ishmael’s sons, the Arabs, giving water and bread to those that fled from the war.

sense.text: “Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots”.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath”: the Carmanians are the Iranians. Iran is going to join battle with the Arabs, “and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.” That Assyrian is talking about the Israelis.

“And then shall the dragons have the upper hand”: for a moment they are going to have the upper hand, “remembering their nature”. Right now the Arabs are kissing America’s butt. But now they are joining with Turkey, because Qatar got bombed by the Israelis, and President Erdogan says, didn’t I tell you? Didn’t Saddam Hussein tell all of us? Saddam said once they finish with me, they will come for the rest of you, and nobody listened. Qatar is friends with America, and the Israelis don’t care. We must unite.

“If they shall turn themselves, conspiring together in great power to persecute them”. All those Arab nations are going to conspire together to persecute the Israelis. Qatar called an emergency Arab-Islamic summit with fifty-seven Muslim countries, and Saudi Arabia called for revenge. While that is happening, get yourselves together, brothers and sisters, all of us.
“And from the land of the Assyrians shall the enemy besiege them”: the land of the Israelis, “and consume some of them, and in their host shall be fear and dread, and strife among their kings.”

“Behold clouds from the east and from the north unto the south”. The north is Europe: Russia and Turkey are up there. The south is the Arabs and Africa. The east is Asia, China, North Korea. “They are very horrible to look upon”: that is their ships, “full of wrath and storm.”

“They shall smite down a great multitude of stars upon the earth, even their own star”. The stars are their missiles: that is the Iron Dome. “Even their own star”: their own missile. “And blood shall be from the sword unto the belly, And dung of men unto the camel’s hough.”
“Great storms from the south”: the Arabs and Africa; “and from the north”: Russia, Europe and Turkey; “and another part from the west”: America and Canada.
“The star stirred to cause fear toward the east and west wind”: this missile is going to cause fear toward the east, and it “shall be destroyed.”
“The great and mighty clouds” are their ships. “An horrible star”: these are the ICBM missiles. Notice it is different from the stars we read before, “their own star”; now it says an horrible star.

“Fire, and hail, and flying swords”: flying swords are conventional missiles. “And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.”

“And they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid.” That is America. That is what we read in Jeremiah 50: they are going to come against Babylon. America is going to be afraid, because all those European nations she says she is so friendly with are turning on her.
“Then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.” All that are about Babylon shall bewail her, as Revelation 18 says.

precepts.why:
“Remembering their nature”: what is their nature? “Thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael”, “And he will be a wild man”. How wild? He will have people run into a crowded room with C4 strapped to the chest, promised seventy-two virgins, killing everybody screaming Allahu Akbar.

“His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him”. That means you ain’t got no friends among them. They are true nationalists. It is only black people that are not nationalists. We’re the only dummies; we love everybody, we got to be friends with everybody, and meanwhile we are getting put to death left and right. Stop being stupid. Now Ibrahim Traoré is trying to nationalize Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso, and everybody is mad that black people would try to unite. The spirit is going out into the world, and the word of God has effect: the brothers in Africa teaching and preaching day after day are stirring up the spirits.

A nationalist is somebody who loves their nation, who loves their people. That is the greatest commandment: love your God and love your brother. Every nation is nationalist: the Chinese, the Japanese, white people love their people. It is just us; we were conditioned to hate ourselves and love everyone else. Christ was a nationalist: he came not but for the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

“And he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.” All his brothers, the twelve princes, are together throughout Saudi Arabia, that whole region. That is their nature, and when they remember it, they conspire together.

Remember what we just read: all they that be about her shall bewail her. “And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning”. America is going to get wiped out.

“Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” Ezra’s dust and smoke going up unto heaven is John’s smoke of her burning.

sense.text: “And shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.” Who is returning to Babylon that was destroyed? Their air force and some of their navy. They will be in that war state thinking they still have a base in America. The land is destroyed, but the military ain’t done yet.

“Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.” Who is that? Judas Iscariot, a traitor. Judas betrayed Christ.

This is why every IUIC sanctuary must have an inner circle of loyal brothers, faithful brothers, brothers that know the scriptures and fear God: at least three to five. If you don’t have that, when Jacob’s trouble comes, you will all fall. Not a circle of partiality, brothers who are your circle because they kiss your ass and do what you say. We want loyal brothers, faithful men to the word of God, and traitors will be dealt with.

“But thou, O Lord, be merciful unto me, and raise me up”: that is the third day. “That I may requite them.” To requite is to make appropriate return for a favor, a service or a wrongdoing. Christ says, raise me up so I can get vengeance. That is some beautiful stuff right there.

“By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.” Judas is back. All those people that turned against Christ are back on the earth again.

Some took that bag from the white man to sit up here and sell us out. You’ve got your house and your car, you put the purple on and sit next to us gathering information and reporting back to them. You are the seed of Judas Iscariot, and you are going to get the worst punishment known to mankind for being a traitor. The Most High has special destruction for you, worse than what the heathen is going to get: weeping and gnashing of teeth, excruciating pain after death. Nowhere in the scriptures is there anything good for a sellout and a traitor.

precepts.why: This is that I may requite them: “Behold, he cometh with clouds”. His chariots they call UFOs. “And every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him”. Those people are back: the ones that pierced Christ are back. “And all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.”

That I might requite them: “There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.” Shall not taste of death means you are going to come back, and when he comes in his kingdom, that is when you are going to be finished forever.

The evil spirits back then are back today. He has them reserved: he brought them here to be wicked, to betray us and do evil, and then he will specifically kill them. He was threatening the people listening to him in his time: when I come back to set the kingdom up, you are going to taste what death is like. You won’t get the rite of death like everybody else. You are going to feel it.

sense.text: “Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.” In every IUIC school, some brothers may be weak and feeble, spiritually. Build them up. Build your inner circle up, and then have a circle outside of that: trustworthy, loyal men.

“Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not”. Brothers and sisters, be strong, because at times you might get afraid; the Lord has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, of love and of a sound mind.

“Behold, your God will come with vengeance”. We must believe that our God will come with vengeance, “even God with a recompence”: a requital. “He will come and save you.”

precepts.why:
We read it earlier, and we read it again: “Thy nakedness shall be uncovered”. All these fake Christians talk about America being a Christian society, but their nakedness is uncovered by the word of God. “Yea, thy shame shall be seen”: all the shameful deeds are being revealed with the word of God.

“I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” That is the God who will come with vengeance. Christ ain’t coming back meeting them as a man.

sense.text: “Behold, the Lord’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save”. “But your iniquities have separated between you and your God”. That is our problem: our own iniquities have separated between us and our God, and our sins have hid his face from us.
“Your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.”

“None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth”. Our people don’t call for justice, and they don’t plead for the truth. “They trust in vanity”: they trust in democracy. “And speak lies”: and Christianity. “They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.”

“Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us”. How many times do you turn on the TV and watch the news, and there is some black woman crying about no justice for her son or daughter that was just shot or murdered? Many, many times. “We wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.”

Why? Because we don’t like justice. Ask them, do you want justice? They say yes. Then read them Revelation, that he that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity, and they say, oh no, I don’t want that.

“We grope as if we had no eyes”. Our people act like they have no eyes. You see the evil, you see the death of our people day after day, and you act like, no, I don’t see that. “We are in desolate places as dead men”: our people are like the walking dead.
“We look for judgment, but there is none”: there is no true judgment. “For salvation, but it is far off from us”, because of our sins.

“For our transgressions are multiplied before thee”. When we try to correct the people and rebuke the people, one of our biggest obstacles is Christian black women and those effeminate black men: oh no, no commandments, no laws. “For our transgressions are with us”.

“In transgressing and lying against the Lord”: that is Christianity. Everything Christians say about God is a lie, some lie they heard from their mama or their stupid pastor. “Speaking oppression and revolt”: democracy and Christianity are oppression and revolt against God. “Words of falsehood”: lie after lie after lie.

“And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off”. Justice stands far off from our people because of our own sins. They call on IUIC to rally behind them, and we go, one time, two times, three times, and we tell the family, this is who we are, repent. Then they go on TV and say, I celebrate Christmas, I love the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ on Easter. “For truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.”

“He that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey”. When you decide to repent, you make yourself a prey to your own people. Your own people hate it when you try to keep the commandments. There is something in our people: it is the white man, that little white man in our brain. “And the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.”

“And he saw that there was no man”: no man that could come and deliver us. Only the Lord can save us; nobody can help us except the Lord. “Therefore his arm brought salvation unto him”: that is Christ.

Christ “put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.” Christ is going to put on his garments of vengeance for clothing. A cloak is a cape.

“According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay”. Christ ain’t coming back to play with none of us: “fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies”. “To the islands he will repay recompence.” Don’t think you are going to be in the midst of sin and escape to your island, I’m going back to Jamaica, I’m going back to Haiti. That ain’t going to work. Christ will find you too.

“So shall they fear the name of the Lord from the west”. Guess what, brothers: we live in the west, the western hemisphere. “And his glory from the rising of the sun”: that is our brothers in the east, the eastern hemisphere, England and Africa over there.

“When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him.” Isaiah sees the enemy coming against us like a flood, but the Lord is only going to allow Esau to do but so much.
“And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob”. It ain’t talking about all nations. Christ is looking for the seed of Jacob to turn from transgression.

“This is my covenant with them”: this is God’s covenant with us. “My spirit that is upon thee”: God’s spirit on us is the holy spirit. “My words which I have put in thy mouth”: the words of the Bible. They “shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed”, our children, “nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed”, our children’s children, “from henceforth and for ever.”

precepts.why:
When the enemy shall come in like a flood: “And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman”. The flood is lies after lies after lies. We are the woman, the bride of Christ. “That he might cause her to be carried away of the flood”: his job is to cause as many Israelites to fall away as possible, in the midst of sin, lies, adultery, fornication and false religions.

“And the earth helped the woman”: the earth is the prophets with the word of God. “The earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.” Only the Bible can swallow up every lie that comes out of Esau’s mouth, because Esau is that serpent.

“And the dragon was wroth with the woman”. His lies didn’t do any good, so now he is madder, and he “went to make war with the remnant of her seed”. That is physical: persecution, Jacob’s time of trouble, tribulation. The remnant “which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.” That is who they are focusing on. All the other Israelites out on the street talking about rape, concubines and multiple women, the white man ain’t dealing with them. It is the group teaching the commandments, because that is changing people’s lives.

A brother pointed out that a lot of the Israelite camps have a new theme now, that the other nations can be saved, because nobody is listening to them and they are not making money anymore; now they are turning Christian. We cannot save the nations.

“For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name”: the city is Jerusalem. “And should ye be utterly unpunished?” Should you other nations be utterly unpunished? “Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the Lord of hosts.”

God said, if I punish my own people, what makes you think you are going to be unpunished? America, England, Japan, Australia: all these nations are going to get it. If we got it, they are going to get it. God wouldn’t be just if he let them off the hook. He says vengeance is mine, I will repay. That is why the Redeemer comes to them that turn from transgression in Jacob, and not to all nations.

“But the righteous live for evermore”. There is no death to the righteous. If you are in this truth keeping the commandments in the faith of Christ, you live forever. No matter what happens, our brothers and sisters whose bodies have passed and returned to the dust, those spirits are coming back. “Their reward also is with the Lord, and the care of them is with the most High.” We have to believe that.

“Therefore shall they receive a glorious kingdom”: the glorious kingdom shall be on earth, New Jerusalem, “and a beautiful crown from the Lord’s hand”. We are going to be crowned with power. “For with his right hand shall he cover them, and with his arm shall he protect them.”

“He shall take to him his jealousy for complete armour”: Christ is coming back for war, “and make the creature his weapon for the revenge of his enemies.” That leviathan is going to come out and attack them bastards in the navy. “He shall put on righteousness as a breastplate”: that is what we read in Isaiah, “and true judgment instead of an helmet.” “His severe wrath shall he sharpen for a sword, and the world shall fight with him against the unwise.”

“Then shall the right aiming thunderbolts go abroad; and from the clouds, as from a well drawn bow, shall they fly to the mark.” Those weapons ain’t going to miss. “And hailstones full of wrath shall be cast as out of a stone bow”, like in the time of Joshua, “and the water of the sea shall rage against them”: tsunamis. “Thus iniquity shall lay waste the whole earth, and ill dealing shall overthrow the thrones of the mighty.”

That is what we are waiting for: the second coming of Christ. And in so waiting, we must be preparing our hearts, our minds and our souls.
